programmes.d: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programmes.d: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal. When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted. The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.
When law enforcement officers become targets, no one is safe. So when a crystal meth dealer on the run from the law began shooting cops, it took more than police to stop him.

programmes.d: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.
Efter næsten at have mistet livet i “Daredevil” er superheltinden ELEKTRA tilbage i en verden af drab og bedrag – stærkere, smukkere og smidigere end før, men...

Fem år efter den amerikanske borgerkrig rammes en nedslidt mand i en lysning af et skud i skulderen. Han flygter, og oberst Morsman Carver træder frem. Han er ude efter hævn, og det bliver en jagt, der fører de to mænd vidt omkring i Amerika.

Paul Maguire (Nicolas Cage) lever et regelret liv efter en fortid som kriminel. Men hans fortid indhenter ham, da den russiske mafia kidnapper hans datter. Han tvinges til at genoptage de ulovlige metoder for at skaffe sin datter tilbage og få hævn.
En ung skotte rejser gennem det vilde vesten for at finde sin tabte kærlighed. Han allierer sig med en mystisk fremmed på en farefuld færd.

Videospildesigner Matt Booth har én chance for at redde sin karriere ved at løfte sløret for sit største projekt til dato til Video Game-prisuddelingen i New Mexico. Men i en brandert ender han i det RIGTIGE Mexico, nærmere bestemt Acapulco.

In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programmes.d: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programmes.d: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programmes.d: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.
